name: Blossom Lady
original_name: เกี้ยวกระดังงา
overview: Viranya once swore to her older sister that she’d never fall for a woman her sister’s age, but fate had other plans. One day, she found herself irresistibly drawn to the gentleness of Patcharin—her 35-year-old secretary. This shouldn’t have happened, after all, Viranya had always preferred younger women. To make matters even more complicated, this secretary was a single mother. It didn’t feel like her at all, as if everything about Patcharin lured her in, like a butterfly helplessly lured by the sweet scent of blooming flowers.Adapted from the novel "Blossom Lady" (เกี้ยวกระดังงา) by 3dokjix (สามดอกจิก).
